messages:
support_jordan: FYI we got an escalated support ticket (ACME Corp) — p99 for chat/generate jumped from ~280ms -> ~1.6s after last night's runtime rollout. Ticket #4567. Customer sees it on long-context sessions (~1.5–2k tokens). Logs: https://redwood.internal/t/4567 :grimacing:
ramon: saw the alert. which kernel path was selected? any heuristic changes pushed in that build?
sre-bot: Alert: p99_spike service=chat-serve-prod region=us-east-1 build=2026-03-16T22:48Z metric=p99_latency delta=+470%
nina: quick glance at traces — heuristic flipped to FlashAttention for sequences >1024 on that build (compile flag sdpa_fallback=false). New kernel has a mem-copy codepath for kv-cache warmups. Could be extra memcpy on large seqs.
matt: ah — we merged the kernel selection update that prefers flashattn for any batch with seq>=512 to improve p50. Didn't think of tail behavior for p99.
elaine: model-level note: some customer prompts include long structured context that triggers KV cache misses; extra memcpy + longer kernel latency explains p95/p99 regression but not p50 impact.
ramon: repro steps I used locally: 
```bash
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=REDACTED
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"rw-large-8k","input":"'"$(printf 'X%.0s' {1..3000})"'","max_tokens":2000}'
```
(you'll hit the same p99 tail in us-east canary)
nina: thanks for repro. quick mitigation options: 1) toggle kernel heuristic back to previous (force SDPA for >1024) 2) rollback runtime image 3) per-deployment kernel override env var REDWOOD_KERNEL_OVERRIDE=sdpa-legacy 4) temporarily route heavy-context customers to dedicated pool.
matt: I'm starting a targeted rollback for us-east canary to image tag 0.98.3 now. Also flipping per-pool override on one nodepool: `kubectl set env ds/chat-runtime REDWOOD_KERNEL_OVERRIDE=sdpa-legacy -n redwood-prod` — will monitor.
elaine: small hotfix suggestion: set KV_CACHE_PARANOID=false and reduce prefetch window to 32 to avoid the extra memcpy during warmup. That reduces tail but could slightly affect throughput.
ramon: capturing perf traces on affected node (pid 4321). nina — can you share an upload endpoint?
nina: upload to s3://redwood-perf/acme-4567/ and paste link. Also include perf.data and a flamegraph.
matt: rollback completed for canary (us-east-1 nodes: pool-a). initial p99 from 1.6s -> 320ms on canary within ~5m. Rolling to rest of us-east over next 25m.
support_jordan: great, please confirm when fully rolled so I can close the customer loop. I'll tell them we have a rollback + scheduled follow-up RCA. :thumbsup:
ramon: after rollout we'll re-run the batch job with the problematic prompt and collect full traces. Also propose adding an AB test for kernel heuristic so we don't flip for all traffic at once next time.
elaine: agree — and add an automated canary that runs long-context synthetic requests to catch p99 regressions. I'll file a ticket for the eval.
sre-bot: Incident note created: INC-2026-0316-ACME-P99. Assigned: eng-runtime.
matt: leaving a short runbook comment in the incident: how to force override, rollback image, and recommended perf artifacts to collect.
support_jordan: ETA update to customer: initial mitigation applied, p99 improved, full roll in progress, expect final update in ~30m.
